resources.string: Tap Sign in with Google first. A Google page opens. We never see that password. Paste a house slip only if you want Unbound Keyboard to polish wording in your voice. A house slip is not a Google, Microsoft, or phone password. Spelling still works before you paste.
Sign in there. Then this phone can use Heirloom. We never ask you to type a Google password here.
Paste the whole house slip here
Unbound Keyboard never reads password, PIN, or card-number boxes. We do not keep other people\'s documents. On iPhone, use Write inside the Heirloom app — Apple does not let us install this keyboard.
